description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Crypt Champion.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Crypt Champion from exile to the battlefield.
Crypt Champion enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Crypt Champion trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have a large amount of Goblin Bombardment triggers, you may stop the loop and deal infinite damage to any target(s).
